mechanism_narrative: Sustained quarterly growth in GDP demand (GDPC1) signals upward momentum, leading to positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 growth slows or turns negative in the next quarter, 20-day returns do not significantly outperform baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.5% signals strong labor market strength, driving positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: If UNRATE does not fall below 4.5% within the next month, 20-day returns remain non-positive.

mechanism_narrative: Concomitant growth in both GDP demand (GDPC1) and supply (INDPRO) amplifies market optimism, generating positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: If the correlation between GDPC1 and INDPRO falls below 0.5 over the horizon, returns do not follow the predicted positive trend.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a sustained decline in federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS) signals monetary easing, boosting equity valuations and driving positive 60-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS does not decline in the late-cycle expansion regime, 60-day returns remain non-positive.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden surge in housing demand (HOUST) above 1800 units signals sector strength, leading to positive 5-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: If HOUST does not exceed 1800 within the next week, 5-day returns remain non-positive.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in the supply index (INDPRO) reflects robust production capacity, fostering positive 60-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: If INDPRO growth stalls or turns negative, 60-day returns do not follow the positive trajectory.

mechanism_narrative: Contractionary monetary policy (rising FEDFUNDS) combined with inflationary pressures (rising CPIAUCSL) creates a negative feedback loop, reducing S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS rises while CPIAUCSL does not, or vice versa, returns do not follow the predicted negative trend.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, a sustained decline in federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS) signals policy accommodation, driving positive 60-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS does not decline in the tightening cycle, 60-day returns remain non-positive.
